refactor_plan.title: Relocate Calculated Segments Info Text
refactor_plan.description: Move 'Calculated: X Segments...' text from VIDEO_LENGTH_SLIDER info to a new HTML component.

changes.details: Add 'gr.HTML(elem_id=ComponentKey.CALCULATED_SEGMENTS_HTML.value, value="", visible=False)' in a new gr.Row above PREVIEW_FREQUENCY_SLIDER.
Modify VIDEO_LENGTH_SLIDER: set 'label="Video Length (s)"', remove 'info' argument.

Change the output target for the segment calculation event chain (likely from `helpers.ui_update_total_segments`) to `ComponentKey.CALCULATED_SEGMENTS_HTML` instead of `ComponentKey.VIDEO_LENGTH_SLIDER`.
Modify `ui_update_total_segments` to return a dictionary targeting `ComponentKey.CALCULATED_SEGMENTS_HTML` with the formatted HTML string for its 'value'.

refactor_plan.title: Flatten Input Component Styles in Top Panel
refactor_plan.description: Apply a new CSS class to remove borders, backgrounds, and shadows from specific input components.

changes.details: Add a new CSS class '.flat-input { background-color: transparent !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; }'.
Add 'elem_classes="flat-input"' to PROMPT, NEGATIVE_PROMPT, MANUAL_PREVIEW_IMAGE, and PREVIEW_SEGMENTS_TEXTBOX components.

refactor_plan.title: Style Queue Dataframe for Theme Consistency
refactor_plan.description: Apply custom CSS to the QUEUE_DF to match the dark theme.

changes.details: Add CSS rules targeting the QUEUE_DF's `elem_id` (e.g., '#queue_df_id table, #queue_df_id th, #queue_df_id td') to set `border-bottom: 1px solid #374151;`, vertically center cell content, style the header row, and style scrollbars.
Add `elem_id="queue_df_id"` to the QUEUE_DF component if it doesn't already have one, to allow for targeted CSS.

refactor_plan.title: Fix Progress Bar HTML Rendering
refactor_plan.description: Ensure PROGRESS_BAR_HTML renders correctly by yielding `gr.update` objects.

changes.details: Locate the part of the generator function that yields updates for PROGRESS_BAR_HTML. Change the yield statement to `yield {ComponentKey.PROGRESS_BAR_HTML: gr.update(value=html_string)}` where `html_string` is the raw HTML content.

refactor_plan.title: Standardize and Refine Button Styles
refactor_plan.description: Apply consistent styling to various buttons across the UI.

changes.details: Add CSS classes: '.muted-blue-button' for image buttons, '.primary-button' (orange), '.secondary-button' (dark gray/outline), and '.destructive-button' (red).

Apply '.muted-blue-button' to REPLACE_IMAGE_BUTTON and DOWNLOAD_IMAGE_BUTTON. Apply primary, secondary, or destructive classes to ADD_TO_QUEUE_BUTTON, PROCESS_QUEUE_BUTTON, SAVE_QUEUE_BUTTON, LOAD_QUEUE_BUTTON, and STOP_PROCESSING_BUTTON based on their intended action/hierarchy.
